dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Hey, outlander. You've a good pair of eyes... Wanna test them by setting your "Eyes on the Feathered Prize"?

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Hone your vision, and be rewarded.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's a concise explanation. Maybe too concise. Barely feels like you said anything at all...

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Detailed rules for later, if you want to try.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's hear the rules, then.

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Three Qucusaurs will fly off. Keep your eye on the middle one...

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: When they all fly back, <color=#00E1FFFF>recognize... the one originally in the middle</color>. That's it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, so they'll switch positions mid-flight, and we gotta figure out which one was originally in the center?

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Correct indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... No wonder you call this eyesight training.

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Start simple to test the waters?

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: And if there's no trouble, we play for real.

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Rewards are yours if you succeed.

choices.text: I've got something else on, so I'll be back later.
Alright, I'll give it a try.

response.speaker: Muepu

dialogues.speaker: Muepu

dialogues.speaker: Muepu

choices.text: Alright, I'll give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: No more prizes left. No more prizes, no more challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Any other questions?

choices.text: Could you tell me more about "Eyes on the Feathered Prize"?

response.speaker: Muepu
response.text: Passed down in the tribe from long ago...

response.speaker: Muepu
response.text: Keen eyes are critical to us, the Flower-Feather Clan.

response.speaker: Muepu
response.text: This generation, I am in charge.

choices.text: Is there a reason why you speak so slowly...?

response.speaker: Muepu
response.text: Previous injury. Fell from a very high place...

response.speaker: Muepu
response.text: Throat and chest... Can't speak like before.

response.speaker: Muepu
response.text: But I don't think it's... too terrible.

choices.text: No worries, no questions for you.

dialogues.speaker: Muepu
dialogues.text: Hey, outlander. Want to try "Eyes on the Feathered Prize"?
